[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- uart_pin_warns.volt:4[/yellow bold]

GPIO 1 is UART0 (TX) — using it will break serial communication.

 [dim]3 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin x: Output = 1
